Its carapace is high-domed, dark grey/black, and appears smooth but with some sediment/dirt. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small lateral eye. The front left limb is visible, planted on the ground, showing distinct digits with claws. The plastron is partially visible underneath but mostly obscured by the angle and shadow. The background is out-of-focus gravel.
